Supplier contract clauses.insurance: The Hirer must insure the equipment against loss and damage while it is at the Hirer's premises.
Supplier contract clauses.renewal: After the minimum rental period the agreement continues from year to year; either party may end it at the end of the minimum rental period, or of any later year, by giving at least six months' written notice.

Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract meets the policy on payment terms, but falls short on renewal notice and is missing a liability cap and public liability insurance.

findings.note: Payment is due within 45 days, more than the 30 days the policy asks for.
The contract does not limit the supplier's liability.

findings.contract_says: The Hirer must insure the equipment against loss and damage while it is at the Hirer's premises.
findings.note: Only the customer must insure the equipment; the contract does not require the supplier to hold public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: After the minimum rental period the agreement continues from year to year; either party may end it at the end of the minimum rental period, or of any later year, by giving at least six months' written notice.
findings.note: It continues automatically from year to year, but the customer needs six months' notice to stop it, more than the policy's three months.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
